_comment: Single source of truth for model pricing. USD per 1M tokens, Amazon Bedrock on-demand, us-east-1 / US cross-region inference profiles (verified against Cost Explorer usage-type unit rates 2026-09-08: fable-5-1 = 11/55 input/output, cache-read 0.275 (2.5% of input, NOT the 10% every other Anthropic model bills), cache-write 13.75 (5m) / 22 (1h); fable-5 = 11/55 with 1.1 cache-read; opus-5/4-8 = 5.5/27.5; sonnet-5 = 2.2/11; haiku-4-5 = 1.1/5.5). Keys match gen_ai.request.model values seen in spans - both bare model names (Claude Code CLI) and Bedrock inference-profile ids (Strands personas). cachedInputDiscount = default cache-read rate as a fraction of input; a model may override it with an absolute cacheReadInput (USD per 1M). cacheWriteMultiplier = cache-write rate as a multiple of input, keyed by hub.cache_ttl (5m|1h) with a default fallback (TEAM-3954). kiro.usdPerCredit converts Kiro credits (its only usage unit) to USD for cross-engine comparison. HISTORY: fable-5-1 sat at 20/100 from TEAM-3849 through 2026-09-08 (flagged as unresolved in TEAM-3954); Cost Explorer settled it at 11/55 and REPORT_VERSION 4 backfilled every card.

cacheWriteMultiplier._basis: Bedrock prompt-cache write surcharge as a multiple of the base input rate: 5-minute cache = 1.25x, 1-hour cache = 2x input (Anthropic on-demand cache-write pricing). Keyed by the span's hub.cache_ttl (TEAM-3953); 'default' applies when ttl is absent/unknown (e.g. coding-CLI usage records).

kiro._basis: Kiro Pro $20/mo / 1000 credits (lowest public tier, per aws.amazon.com/q/developer/faqs); overage rate is $0.04/credit

agentcore._basis: AgentCore Runtime consumption pricing us-east-1, verified against Cost Explorer unit rates 2026-09
